---
title: "MSstats-multiple-comparisons_conversion"
author: "Andrew Becker"
output: html_document
date: "2025-04-08"
R_version: "4.4.2"
description: "Converts MSstats comparison results into separate dataframes for each comparison condition. Transforms data into a format suitable for downstream visualization, handling infinite values and missing data appropriately."
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --- SETUP: Load required libraries ---
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(here)
library(pbapply)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(readxl)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)

# --- LOAD CONFIGURATION ---
source(here::here("src", "config.R"))
```

```{r data_loading}
# --- DATA LOADING ---
# Read MSstats comparison results
setwd("C:/Users/andbp/Documents/R_data/MSstats_data-transform/")
data <- read.csv("comparison_results_search5_median-norm.csv")

unique_labels <- unique(data$Label)
```

```{r data_processing}
# --- DATA PROCESSING ---
# Create separate dataframe for each comparison label
# Handles infinite FC values by capping at ±10

# Create a list to store all dataframes
label_dataframes <- list()

# For each unique label, create a separate dataframe
for(label in unique_labels) {
  # Filter data for current label
  subset_data <- data %>%
    filter(Label == label) %>%
    # Select and rename columns to standardized format
    select(
      ProteinID = Protein,
      Label,
      FC = log2FC,
      p_value = pvalue,
      adj.pvalue = adj.pvalue,
      SE,
      Tvalue = Tvalue,
      DF
    ) %>%
    # Handle infinite values in FC
    mutate(
      FC = case_when(
        FC == Inf ~ 10,
        FC == -Inf ~ -10,
        TRUE ~ FC
      ),
      # Add empty columns to match desired format
      diffexpressed = NA,
      selected_labels = NA
    )
  
  # Store the dataframe in the list with the label as the name
  label_dataframes[[label]] <- subset_data
}
```

```{r export}
# --- EXPORT: Save each comparison to a separate CSV file ---
for(label in unique_labels) {
  write.csv(label_dataframes[[label]], 
            file = paste0(label, "_search5_median-norm_transformed-data_4May25.csv"), 
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```
